en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1116 - It was narrated from Isma'il ibn Muslim that he asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

about praying behind a man who denies (or rejects) the decree (Qadar) of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic.
He (Al-Sadiq) replied: "He should repeat every prayer he performed behind him”.
